name: Arief Didu
bio: Arief Budiman, professionally known as Arief Didu, is an Indonesian comedian, actor, and woodworking craftsman. Born on February 8, 1973, in Jakarta, Indonesia, he initially pursued a career as a designer in the custom woodworking industry.
